meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查 claude-mem 保存的跨会话历史:按「搜索→时间线→取详情」分层检索旧会话记录,先返回带 ID、时间的标题索引与摘要,摘要不够时才取原始工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问的是以往会话而不是当前对话时触发,例如「这个问题之前修过吗」「上次 X 是怎么做的」「上周发生了什么」等。

say.text: 上周我们是怎么修好那个 bug 的?
say.note: 先搜索记忆库,给出带 ID 的标题索引

say.text: 搜索本项目里跟 migration 相关的记录
把那次命令的原始输出调出来
say.note: 摘要不够时才取原始工具输入输出

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory in layers: search -> timeline -> fetch. It first returns titles with IDs and timestamps plus summaries, and only pulls raw tool I/O when the summary is not enough.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current conversation — e.g. "did we already fix this?", "how did we do X last time?", or "what happened last week?".

say_en.text: How did we fix that bug last week?
say_en.note: Searches the memory index first, returns titles with IDs

say_en.text: Search this project for records about migration
say_en.note: Returns a list of results and summaries

say_en.text: Pull up the raw output of that command
say_en.note: Only used when a summary is not enough
